rows.text: Il quiz indica VERO. Le linee guida attuali per chi presta soccorso a un adulto non cosciente indicano di chiamare subito i soccorsi e controllare la respirazione mentre la chiamata si collega, senza ritardare l’aiuto cercando il polso. Se il respiro è assente o anormale, iniziare la rianimazione seguendo la centrale.
evidence: European Resuscitation Council 2025 Adult Basic Life Support, pp.2–3 https://www.erc.edu/media/wrhj5sye/gl2025-04-bls-e.pdf: check response, immediately call if unresponsive, assess breathing while call connects; start CPR for absent or abnormal breathing and follow dispatcher. Initial lay sequence does not require a pulse search.
The source quiz prints VERO without stating whether the responder is a clinician; no invented clinical-only interpretation or unverified historical rationale.

source_access_notes: Independently reviewed ERC 2025 first aid and adult basic life support guidelines, Red Cross unresponsive casualty guidance (movement for safety, CPR or bleeding control), Royal Wolverhampton NHS helmet and trauma guidance, and Italian assistance provisions. 31595/31597 explicitly scope the lay sequence to adults; 31584–31589/31598 preserve urgent lifesaving exceptions without advising unnecessary movement.

issues.reason: Il quiz stampa VERO per la verifica immediata del battito da parte di chiunque soccorra un incosciente, ma le istruzioni correnti per soccorritori laici chiedono di valutare risposta e respirazione, senza verifica del polso; non è chiarito se il quesito intenda personale qualificato o una procedura superata. Serve adjudicazione indipendente prima di conciliare il verdetto con la guida attuale.

issues.reason: The explanation says to leave/wait or move only for immediate environmental danger, omitting urgent positioning needed for CPR or control of life-threatening bleeding. Retain the printed verdict and minimise movement, but make urgent lifesaving care and dispatcher guidance explicit. American Red Cross General Care https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/resources/learn-first-aid/unresponsive-and-breathing-person directly lists safety, CPR and bleeding exceptions; ERC 2025 adult BLS requires prompt CPR for absent/abnormal breathing.

prior_review_findings.review_evidence: All 25 Italian questions/verdicts and four languages reviewed; no figures. ERC 2025 first aid and adult BLS directly inspected; 31595/31597 properly call immediately, assess breathing and begin CPR when abnormal without delaying for pulse. American Red Cross directly inspected movement exceptions for CPR and severe bleeding; 31584–86 omit these and can imply waiting instead of lifesaving care. 31587–89 and 31598 use example wording, but may benefit from explicit urgent-care context. Normattiva 2016 reproduces CdS189(1); Gazzetta art593, NHS helmet and European Commission emergency numbers inspected.
